title: Box-Cox Transformations of Correlation Matrices
abstract: arXiv:2611.09790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider Box-Cox transformations of correlation matrices, $\Phi_\alpha(C)=\mathrm{vecl}\{(C^{\alpha}-I)/\alpha\}$, with Jacobian $J_\alpha$. The family nests the raw correlations at $\alpha=1$, the generalised Fisher transformation (GFT), $C\mapsto\mathrm{vecl}(\log C)$, at $\alpha=0$, and the negated off-diagonal concentration coordinates at $\alpha=-1$. The inverse problem is a strictly convex program for every $\alpha$, so every member is injective. The map is onto $\mathbb{R}^{d}$, $d=n(n-1)/2$, if and only if $\alpha\le0$, such that $\alpha=0$ defines the boundary for unrestricted parametrizations. For $\alpha>0$ the image is bounded. The conditioning obeys the bound $\kappa(J_\alpha)\le\kappa(C)^{|1-\alpha|}$, where $\kappa(C)=\lambda_{\max}(C)/\lambda_{\min}(C)$, and on the surjective range the exponent is smallest at $\alpha=0$. translated_title: 相关矩阵的 Box-Cox 变换
translated_abstract: 我们研究相关矩阵的 Box-Cox 变换 Φ_α(C)=vecl{(C^α − I)/α}，其雅可比矩阵为 J_α。该变换族在 α=1 时嵌入了原始相关系数，在 α=0 时嵌入了广义 Fisher 变换（GFT），即 C↦vecl(log C)，在 α=−1 时嵌入了取负的非对角集中坐标。逆问题对每个 α 都是严格凸规划，因此该族中的每个变换都是单射。该映射是到 ℝ^d（d=n(n−1)/2）的满射当且仅当 α≤0，因此 α=0 构成了无约束参数化的边界。当 α>0 时，其像是有界的。条件数满足界 κ(J_α)≤κ(C)^|1−α|，其中 κ(C)=λ_max(C)/λ_min(C)，并且在满射范围内，该指数在 α=0 时最小。在高斯抽样且 n≥3 的条件下，变换后样本相关系数的渐近协方差……（原文摘要到此被截断）
tldr: 提出了相关矩阵的单参数 Box-Cox 变换族，统一了原始相关系数、广义 Fisher 变换和集中坐标等经典变换，并系统证明了其逆问题的严格凸性、单射性、满射条件（当且仅当 α≤0）以及雅可比条件数在 α=0 时最优等关键性质。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a one-parameter family of Box-Cox transformations of correlation matrices that unifies raw correlations, the generalized Fisher transformation, and concentration coordinates, establishing strict convexity of the inverse problem (hence injectivity), characterizing surjectivity (if and only if α≤0, with α=0 as the boundary for unconstrained parametrizations), and proving the Jacobian conditioning bound κ(J_α)≤κ(C)^|1−α| is minimized at α=0.
